name: lean-bridge
cmd:
export LEAN_PATH=$PWD:$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(elan which lean))))/lib/lean; for f in Cert Kernel Cyclic Progress StepLaw Steps Sets History Live Ghost Refine; do { [ -f $f.olean ] || lean -o $f.olean $f.lean; } > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo build-failed $f; exit 1; }; done; for f in Bridge BridgeRules; do lean -o $f.olean $f.lean > $f.out 2>&1 || { grep -B2 -A25 error $f.out | head -80; echo build-failed $f; exit 1; }; if grep -q -e sorry -e sorryAx $f.out; then echo sorry-in $f; exit 1; fi; done; printf 'import BridgeRules
#print axioms Kern.cyc_machine_sound
#print axioms Kern.cyc_machine_holds
#print axioms Kern.cyc_recur_sound
#print axioms Kern.cyc_fold_sound
#print axioms Kern.cyc_kstep_sound
#print axioms Kern.sleads_of_holds
#print axioms Kern.hreach_plain
#print axioms Kern.cyc_ghost_holds
#print axioms Kern.cyc_allow_sound
#print axioms Kern.sleads_wf_of_holds
#print axioms Kern.srefines_of_holds
#print axioms Kern.cyc_qmachine_sound
#print axioms Kern.cyc_qkstep_sound
#print axioms Kern.cyc_qallow_sound
' > ax.lean; lean ax.lean
